title: An operating system for deliberate changes
question: The approved practical, code-first direction is the assigned reserve survey system. This board records its alternatives; no new blocking interview is required.

options.label: Nature reserve survey sheets
options.lineage: Reserve inventory sheets and field observations
options.thesis: Every instance gets a clear working record and an observed readiness line.
options.viewport: Familiar side navigation and instance toolbar lead into the task heading, lifecycle line, current observations, and recent jobs.
options.risk: Restrained color cannot substitute for complete states and useful data density.

raised.raise: Dense data must retain a strict hierarchy and unmistakable units.
Every work area must have an unmistakable primary action.
Instance and job identities stay consistent across every route.
Group compact information without hiding it inside nested containers.
Type hierarchy must remain decisive even without display theatrics.
Lifecycle order must be explicit and unknown stages must remain open.

options.label: Community field guide
options.thesis: Task groups read like a compact reference for the instance.
options.viewport: The same standard shell with a compact summary and task-specific reference tables.
options.risk: Familiar and effective, but also the conventional grounded destination for this category.

options.label: Ikeda Datamatics
options.thesis: Compress the system into precise observations.
options.viewport: A standard admin shell with a dense data-first work area.
options.risk: Literal audiovisual expression obscures readiness and safety.
options.case: Loses audience identification and operational clarity against the grounded reserve system.
options.kept: Data-density discipline without the audiovisual costume.

options.label: Vertical video feed
options.thesis: Make the next primary action unmistakable.
options.viewport: Standard navigation with one leading operation in each work area.
options.risk: Feed behavior conflicts with dense, simultaneous administration.
options.case: Loses both axes when translated literally.

options.label: Saville catalog sleeve
options.viewport: Standard navigation with stable instance and job identifiers.
options.risk: Sleeve-like withholding of information hurts safety.
options.case: Loses both axes as the governing world.
options.kept: Stable identifiers and calibrated information hierarchy.

options.label: Cassette J-card
options.thesis: Group compact facts without wasting space.
options.viewport: A standard workspace with concise task groups and readable tables.
options.risk: A sleeve costume would compete with operational meaning.
options.case: Loses both axes when used as the visual world.

options.label: Emigre bitmap specimen
options.thesis: Create hierarchy that survives at high density.
options.viewport: A standard admin shell with deliberate title, label, and data scales.
options.risk: Bitmap typography harms sustained reading and accessibility.
options.case: Loses both axes as literal expression.

options.label: Labanotation
options.thesis: Show sequence without hiding unobserved states.
options.viewport: Standard navigation with a semantic lifecycle line above the current observations.
options.risk: Specialized notation is unfamiliar to server administrators.
options.case: Loses both axes as a notation-led interface.
options.kept: Explicit lifecycle order, not specialist symbols.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar administration UI, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional side rail, toolbar, status summary, and work tables.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from peer panels by design.
